flyer.justification: The flyer captures the main themes accurately with strong formatting, though the title slightly exceeds the 6-word limit.

linkedin.justification: The LinkedIn post follows all formatting instructions, avoids banned buzzwords, and delivers an engaging, factually faithful message.

instagram.justification: The caption successfully includes carousel cues, emoji formatting, clear takeaways, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter is conversational and well-structured with three bold subheadings, though the subject line exceeds the 50-character limit.

summary.justification: The executive briefing is succinct, well under the 400-word limit, and organizes key strategic insights effectively into required sections.

blog.justification: The blog post adheres perfectly to all long-form requirements, featuring numbered insight sections, an accurate comparison table, and the author profile.
